_comment: Copy to golden.json and fill expectedTurnIds after ingest. Each question is paired with the turn id(s) that actually contain the answer (printed by `recall ask` under '--- retrieved turns ---', or found in Postico). recall@5 counts a question as a hit if ANY expected id is in the top 5. Leave expectedTurnIds off a question to time it without scoring it. The spec's mix: ~6 time-bounded, ~4 exact-token, ~4 paraphrase, ~3 person, ~3 no-answer.
